mutations.name: a removed or unmeasured snapshot reads as not over the threshold
kills: the evidence comment's Visual diff section marks a share over the threshold, and a removed or unmeasured snapshot as failing closed

mutations.name: the shadow line shows under on instead of shadow
kills: the evidence comment's Visual diff section says in shadow what on would decide, clear or the gate's reason

mutations.name: a pipe in a snapshot path is not escaped
kills: the evidence comment's Visual diff section escapes a pipe a PR put in a snapshot path, so the row keeps four cells

mutations.name: every row repeats its component instead of grouping
kills: the evidence comment's Visual diff section groups rows by component with the largest change first, and collapses more than five rows

mutations.name: a malformed delta is rendered without the schema check
mutations.find: if (!VisualDeltaSchema.safeParse(delta).success) return ["", "**Visual diff**: the recorded delta is malformed, so it reads as unmeasured."];
kills: the evidence comment's Visual diff section says a malformed delta reads as unmeasured, and shows nothing without one
